We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (initial_molecule) reproduces the reaction: carboxylic acid to amide via coupling agent. The molecule: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional groups broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid? The forward reaction breaks C-O of carboxylic acid, forms C-N amide. So broken functional group: "aliphatic carboxylic acid". Formed functional group: "amide". Also bond broken: C-O (maybe "C-O" but need format like "6-8"? Not sure). Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.

Let's call search with functional_groups_broken = ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"], functional_groups_formed = ["amide"], limit maybe 5.
